builds.howItPlays: You take battlefields early with cheap units, then use Diana's extra Energy, which she can only spend during fights, on 1-cost reactions like Gust, which sends an enemy unit with 3 Might or less back to its owner's hand. Ride the Wind moves one of your units and readies it, and each time Hwei, Brooding Painter moves he draws a card, discards a card, and gets a bonus based on what you threw away.
builds.whyYou: You like games where each turn comes down to one fight over a battlefield, and you want to be the one holding the answer. You enjoy keeping a cheap reaction ready during your opponent's turn and moving your units in and out at just the right moment. You don't mind tracking a lot at once, and you like that a win here comes from reading your opponent and not from a lucky draw. If careful timing sounds more fun to you than raw speed, Diana is worth learning.
builds.ratingNotes: Scored decks (current rubric, blind to the Build on file): Diana Hwei v100 (VEN post ban), Justice, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/44379da0-710a-40d9-9d18-6670d05ab829 Tempo 6/5.5/7.5/3.5; God Save The Queen, RiftRunner91, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/44f0cad2-b511-494e-9d3c-e6926bca074f Tempo 5.5/5/7.5/4.5; Diana, therealjoshmoore, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/1b9c7284-97a4-4c14-bd6d-1002f34f8f92 Tempo 6/5/8/4. tools.ts style: Tempo 6/5/7.5/4, mean of 3, labels Tempo x3. Adjustment (all three decks): complexity +1, because the Legend adds 1 Energy usable only in showdowns, a timing choice every turn. Deciding cards: pace comes from 8-9 two-cost units (Ravenbloom Student, Tideturner, Traveling Merchant, Sprite Fountain) held back by 3 Hwei and other 5-costs. Stance sits near the middle because pressure bodies are balanced by 16-19 answers (Gust, Moonfall, Star-Crossed, Smoke Screen, Hard Bargain, Flash, Vex, Apathetic). Complexity comes from 15-18 reactive cards plus movement setup (Ride the Wind, Flash, Tideturner, Hwei's move trigger). Variance is low from 10-12 removal and 10-12 card-flow cards (Stupefy, Hwei, Traveling Merchant); the only luck card is Diana, Lunari. No axis had a formula/judgment gap of 2 or more. Legend ability: [Reaction] exhaust to add 1 Energy that can only be spent during showdowns. Also played: none (single style). The Maintainer chose Justice's list as the display deck over the script's God Save The Queen (tied on points, more typical of the style, 60 likes).
